description: The exact controlled values agents should use in filters and taste profiles, read from the live catalog with item counts: categories, catalog tiers, price tiers with their price bands, availability, trend statuses with meanings, style tags, silhouettes, occasions, seasons, colors, materials, sizes, conditions and ship-to regions, plus every filter field name with its type. No arguments. Cacheable: call it once per session, before building filters.

inputSchema.description: No inputs needed: one call returns every controlled value and filter field.

anyOf.description: Optional self-identification. Identified callers help us rank better; keys make it reliable.

session_id.description: Your own opaque id linking calls in one shopping session. Never a user id.
